usage: cli.py diff [-h] --prev PREV --curr CURR [--out OUT] [--no-clobber]

options:
  -h, --help    show this help message and exit
  --prev PREV   Path to prev snapshot JSON
  --curr CURR   Path to curr snapshot JSON
  --out OUT     Output diff JSON path (or '-' for stdout)
  --no-clobber  Fail if output file already exists.
